guarantees: YNX first-party DApps can use any approved standard EIP-1193 provider.
External EVM DApps can discover and use YNX Wallet without YNX product registration.
Product Session failures degrade only private first-party capabilities and never fabricate a local session.
No endpoint manifest is activated unless its integrity verifier succeeds.
migration: Run scan:migration, replace direct provider calls with StandardWalletConnection, persist pending callbacks before launch, and opt in to ProductSessionEnhancer only for private routes.
